svg.title: Three radix passes with missing digit positions treated as zero
svg.desc: One complete LSD radix sort of 213, 7, 42, 105, mixing three-, one-, and two-digit values. Each of the three passes shows all ten buckets 0 through 9 horizontally, including empty buckets. Ones gives 42, 213, 105, 7. Tens gives 105, 7, 213, 42. The missing tens digit of 7 is zero, so it follows 105 into bucket 0. The missing hundreds digits of 7 and 42 are zero, so hundreds bucket 0 holds 7 then 42. Hundreds bucket 1 holds 105 and bucket 2 holds 213. Gathering gives the sorted array 7, 42, 105, 213. All values participate in every pass. Stop before thousands because the maximum value 213 divided by 1000 is zero.
svg.text: Missing digit positions count as 0. Every value participates in all three passes.
1. Read the array from left to right
2. Append each value to its ones-digit bucket
3. Gather buckets 0 to 9; read each from top to bottom
1. Read the array from left to right
2. Append each value to its tens-digit bucket
3. Gather buckets 0 to 9; read each from top to bottom
1. Read the array from left to right
2. Append each value to its hundreds-digit bucket
3. Gather buckets 0 to 9; read each from top to bottom
Stop: 213 / 1000 = 0. All three digit positions have been processed.
